question.text: Per Regulation 23 of SEBI (AIF) Regulations, for securities NOT covered by SEBI (MF) Regulations valuation norms, valuation must be done per guidelines endorsed by an AIF industry association. What is the minimum membership threshold for such an association?

answer.text: At least 25% of the total AUM of AIFs in India
At least 10% of SEBI-registered AIFs and approved by AIPAC
At least 50% of the number of SEBI-registered AIFs
At least 33% of the number of SEBI-registered AIFs

explanation.text: The Logic: Such an industry association must represent at least 33% of the NUMBER of SEBI-registered AIFs. It endorses the applicable valuation guidelines after taking into account the recommendations of the Alternative Investment Policy Advisory Committee (AIPAC) of SEBI. This is the basis on which the Indian AIF industry association endorses the IPEV Guidelines. The Trap: 50% is too strict a threshold. The 25% AUM option confuses 'number of AIFs' with 'value of AIFs'. The 10% option is below the regulatory floor. Note: The threshold is based on the NUMBER of SEBI-registered AIFs the association represents, not the assets they manage.
